title: Conditional kappa 0.001672267698427438: whole-helper exchanges on the T16 owner map
body:
Conditional kappa **0.001672267698427438**, **+0.00154449%** over the PR1050 parent (0.001672241870811633). It also exceeds the later PR1055 claim by **0.00096241%**. Repeated whole-helper exchanges improve the exact T16 owner map while preserving the local word, widths, call order and source-event times.

Only the frozen owner data and measured pins change. The package preserves the exact PR1050 source archive and upstream notices, with a source manifest, all 24 changed placements, a reproduction command and explicit conditional scope. No verifier checks are changed.

Validation: published as a draft, then the publication wrapper passed a fresh complete replay through the unchanged strict verifier: 69 admission controls, 12 bit controls, 15 controller mutations, six independent owner controls, exact arithmetic and all 47 outer inequalities. The replay reproduces **0.001672267698427438**. The final uploaded files were compared byte-for-byte by Git blob hash. VALIDATION.json records the environment and checks. Hosted CI remains separate. This reuses the checked PR1018 native replay and PR1005 chain; it is not a full cold ancestry rebuild.

All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer and PR589 bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. No unconditional theorem, global packing optimum or Lean claim.

Credits: PR1050 and preceding owner-packing work; FanPUYen PR858; PR1018 including rohanarun PR987; PR1005; NewBArch PR869 and the retained PR799/741/685/645/589 supplier lineage. Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new material Apache-2.0.
